meta.title: LikasLens — CSC AVP (extended cut)
meta.audience: CSC HR Innovation Lab (Vivian Bravo, then the regional director)
meta.why: Extended from the 81 s cut at the owner's request to show more of the platform: the report flow carried through to submission, the hazard maps, the law library, the public record and tracking, and the LGU accountability screens.

meta.layout: The phone sits right at 608x1080 and the rest of the frame is filled with a blurred, darkened copy of the same screen, so no scene is mostly empty. Full-frame desktop scenes keep a lower third. Text is rasterised by Chromium because ffmpeg's drawtext is unavailable on this build.

cutScenes.reason: The original offline-queue scene was cut because the page never left its loading state. It is retried in this cut as s17 only if it renders a real pending item.

voice.speedNote: Measured, not guessed: at 0.95 this voice reads about 145 wpm. narration/synthesize.mjs writes the resulting durations back into this file.

voice.pronunciationNote: Applied to the text sent to synthesis only. Captions and the .srt keep the real spelling. The owner confirms each name by ear.

captions.note: Captions are burned in AND written into the .srt, which assemble.mjs muxes into the MP4 as a mov_text track so they can be turned off.

scenes.title: The problem

visual.photoCredit: JFVelasquez Floro, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
visual.subject: Garbage and plastic pollution in the Marilao River, Bulacan
visual.motion: slow push-in, 1.00 -> 1.08 scale, centred on the water

scenes.caption:
Waste is reaching our rivers
every day.
scenes.narration: A citizen sees waste being dumped into a river. Who do they report it to — and will anyone ever answer?

scenes.title: The citizen's app

visual.note: Home screen: greeting, the Liksi card, the live report summary, and the report button.

scenes.caption:
One report begins in a
citizen's hand.
scenes.narration: LikasLens begins with one photo. This is the citizen's app: what they have reported, and what is happening with it.

scenes.title: One photo, Ghost Mode

visual.note: Ghost Mode switched on, then the camera opened and a real capture taken from the fake device.

scenes.caption:
One photo. Ghost Mode keeps
the reporter anonymous.
scenes.narration: They take one photo. The location is recorded with it. And when reporting feels risky, Ghost Mode keeps the reporter anonymous.

scenes.title: The AI reads the photo

visual.note: The real triage response, from the AI service, with the labels it actually returned.

scenes.caption:
The AI flags what it
recognises. A person confirms.
scenes.narration: Our AI reads the photo and flags what it recognises. Nothing is final: an analyst confirms it before anything is acted on.

scenes.title: The citizen still decides

visual.note: The category grid. The citizen picks; the model does not.

scenes.caption:
The AI does not choose
the category. The citizen does.
scenes.narration: The citizen still says what they think it is. The AI does not decide that for them.

scenes.title: Filed and given a reference

visual.note: The success screen with the reference id and the five-stage dispatch pipeline. The submit call is intercepted at the browser boundary, so no report is written anywhere.

scenes.caption:
Filed, referenced, and
given a pipeline.
scenes.narration: The report is filed and given a reference number. From here it has a trail: received, assigned for inspection, and finally resolved.

scenes.title: My submissions

visual.note: History list, then a detail sheet showing the handling office, the environmental law and the response target.

scenes.caption:
Handling office, law,
and response target.
scenes.narration: Every report stays in the citizen's history, with the office handling it, the law that applies, and the response target.

scenes.title: The hazard map

visual.note: The heatmap over the Philippine basemap, with the severity legend and the report count. Tiles take several seconds to paint, so the scene waits for the canvas instead of a fixed sleep.

scenes.caption:
Where the trouble is
concentrating.
scenes.narration: On the hazard map, reports from across the country become a picture of where trouble is concentrating.

actions.why: Carto vector tiles need to paint; there is no DOM event for 'map finished drawing'

scenes.title: Community reports
scenes.caption:
And what neighbours
have reported.
scenes.narration: They can also see what other people have reported nearby.

scenes.title: Liksi

visual.note: The chat opened and a real question asked. The answer is live Gemini through the AI service, scoped to Philippine law by the server-side prompt.

scenes.caption:
Liksi answers in
plain language.
scenes.narration: Liksi, the built-in assistant, answers questions about Philippine environmental law in plain language. It names the statutes, and it is clear that a person still decides.

actions.value: Which Philippine law covers plastic waste in a river?

scenes.title: The law library

visual.note: The statutes the routing is built on.

scenes.caption:
The statutes behind
the routing.
scenes.narration: Behind the routing is a library of Philippine environmental law, each statute with its penalties.

scenes.title: The LGU side

visual.note: Command Center: every report as a ticket, moving across one board.

scenes.caption:
Every report is a ticket
on one board.
scenes.narration: On the government side, every report arrives as a ticket, and moves across one board from new to resolved.

scenes.title: Measured response

visual.note: SLA compliance, average response time and escalations per office.

scenes.caption:
Response time, SLA
compliance, escalations.
scenes.narration: Each office is measured on how fast it responds and whether it meets its service targets. Escalations are counted, not buried.

scenes.title: Accountability

visual.note: The compliance analytics page and its algorithmic risk register — which model routed a report and on what basis.

scenes.caption:
Every automated decision
is registered.
scenes.narration: And the decisions the system makes are recorded, so an office can see which method routed a report and on what basis.

scenes.title: The public record

visual.note: The public feed and its map view. Reporter identity is removed.

scenes.caption:
The public record closes
the loop.
scenes.narration: For the public, the record closes the loop: what was reported, where, and what was actually resolved.

scenes.title: Track a report
scenes.caption:
Follow a report without
an account.
scenes.narration: Any citizen can follow a report by its reference number, without an account.

scenes.title: Offline

visual.note: The queue seeded through the app's own store so the screen shows a real pending item. Included only if it renders; the recorder fails the scene otherwise and it is cut.

scenes.caption:
No signal? The report
waits on the phone.
scenes.narration: No signal in the field? Reports wait on the phone, and send themselves when the connection returns.
